text:
samuel (AE): Quick sync — ZephyrBank wants a 4-week pilot to validate support summarization + automated redaction. Need: prompt inventory, baseline prompts, success metrics, timeline. Also pricing/infra question: hosted vs Dedicated for PII workloads. Any immediate blockers?

jamie (SE): I can drive prompt inventory + baseline. Need example flows from the customer (chat transcripts, support emails). Do we have a redaction spec?

priya (CSE): @samuel they gave sample transcripts in the NDA bucket (s3://zephyr-poc/samples). Ask them for high-priority intents (billing, fraud, onboarding).

samuel (AE): Sent request for intents and top 250 messages. Asked legal to expedite data access. Timeline: week0 onboard, week1 prompt tuning + eval harness, week2 running evals, week3 iteration, week4 handoff.

rachel (Security): Heads up: Zephyr requires data residency in eu-west-1 and HSM-backed key management. Also need answers for: data retention, access review, audit logs. I'll put up the standard RFP answers but want to confirm the PII handling approach.

jamie (SE): Baseline prompt set (first-pass):
- Summarize customer message in <= 3 bullets, include next action.
- Extract named entities: account_id, transaction_id, amount, date.
- Redact PHI/SSN/Account numbers -> replace with <REDACTED>.
Example prompt: 
```
System: You are a support summarizer. Redact any sensitive identifiers. Output JSON with keys: summary, actions, entities, redaction_flags.
User: "Customer: My SSN is 123-45-6789 and I was charged $200 by error..."
```

jamie (SE): Eval plan: automated redaction precision/recall, ROUGE-L for summaries, and manual spot-checks for hallucination. Target: redaction recall >= 99%, summary F1 >= 0.85, hallucination rate < 5%.

zack (Product): Model suggestion: start on hosted with a verified open model (quantized) for fast iteration. If redaction + residency SLOs require, switch to Dedicated Private in eu-west-1. We can enable prefix KV caching to lower cost.

samuel (AE): Pricing ask from procurement: ballpark hosted costs for 4-week pilot? and Dedicated minimum commit?

jamie (SE): Rough numbers: hosted test ~ $4k for the pilot (based on expected 200k tokens), Dedicated baseline commit ~ $18k/mo (3x GPU pool minimum) — need final calc after traffic estimate.

rachel (Security): For security questionnaire: confirm TLS, KMS integration, isolation for logs, and SIEM hooks. Also: will we redact before logs persist? We should document where redaction happens (inference layer vs collector).

priya (CSE): Success criteria proposal to share with customer:
- Functional: 85%+ summary adequacy on sample set, 99%+ redaction recall, latency p95 < 350ms (eu-west-1).
- Operational: deployable on dedicated private within 2 weeks of PO, audit log retention 90 days, key rotation supported.
- Business: evidence of 30% reduction in average handle time on sampled tickets.

samuel (AE): Love that. Who owns the prompt inventory doc and the initial eval harness? Need owners + dates.

jamie (SE): I'll own prompt inventory + baseline prompts. Deliverable: initial inventory + 25 canonical prompts by Tue (1719860000). I'll also push a small eval harness (pytest + dataset).

priya (CSE): I'll handle success criteria doc + customer-facing acceptance tests. Deliverable: acceptance checklist and manual spot-check plan by end of week.

rachel (Security): I'll finish questionnaire answers and list infra blockers (HSM, region, IAM roles) by tomorrow EOD.

ops-bot: Deployment note: eu-west-1 private deployment requires PR for network peering and allowlist. Submit ticket ENG-5221.

samuel (AE): Thanks all — I'll confirm PO timeline and push procurement to approve dedicated option if security sign-off requires it. Tagging @zack for any product constraints. :thumbsup:
